text: yes i am wanting it to behave all the same as something like .bsp files but for game assets
resolution: Confirmed the BSP-for-assets framing against oracle rulings V28/V29. Explained that Studio-compiled .prop/.item/.vehicle/.clothing assets should be cooked, content-addressed, installable binary lump containers with mesh/material/collision/mount/gameplay descriptor lumps, map/world files referencing them by asset id rather than embedding, and behavior limited to engine-supported data parameters. No source changes were made.
